entry.title: I Built a Cellular Automata Explorer in WebAssembly — Here Are 21 Visual Experiments
entry.summary:
The project
Over 21 days in May 2025, I used cellular automata as a daily sketchbook: one tool, one new constraint, one visual experiment per day. The result is CellCosmos — a browser-based elementary cellular automata explorer. The twist: the core automaton logic is written in French-syntax source code using a multilingual programming language I've been building. That French source is compiled to WebAssembly (WASM) and runs at near-native speed in the browser. 🔗 Live tool: multilingualprogramming.github.io/cellcosmos

entry.summary: There's a specific kind of problem that doesn't feel like a problem because you never see it. If your price is too high, you notice. Conversion drops. Prospects push back on calls.
